title: Eagles' undersized center Willie Lampkin continues to impress in the preseason

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Eagles' undersized center Willie Lampkin continues to impress in the preseason
sources.description: A year ago, one of the stars of the NFL preseason was undrafted rookie center Willie Lampkin, who was playing for the Rams and putting on a show, repeatedly knocking opposing defensive linemen on their backs.
